statewideNote: Every Arkansas voter decides these 4 issues.

statewide.title: Citizens-only voting
statewide.what: AN AMENDMENT TO THE ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION TO CREATE "THE CITIZENS ONLY VOTING AMENDMENT"; TO PROVIDE THAT ONLY A CITIZEN OF THE UNITED STATES MEETING THE QUALIFICATIONS OF AN ELECTOR UNDER THE ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION MAY VOTE IN AN ELECTION IN THIS STATE; AND PROVIDING THAT A PERSON WHO DOES NOT MEET THE QUALIFICATIONS OF AN ELECTOR UNDER THE ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION SHALL NOT BE PERMITTED TO VOTE IN ANY STATE OR LOCAL ELECTION HELD IN THIS STATE.
statewide.yes: A YES (FOR) vote adds citizens-only voting language to Article 3 of the Arkansas Constitution, starting Jan. 1, 2027.
statewide.no: A NO (AGAINST) vote keeps the current wording of Article 3, which already lists U.S. citizenship as a voter qualification.
statewide.needs: Each issue passes if more people vote FOR it than AGAINST it.

statewide.title: Right to keep and bear arms
statewide.what: AN AMENDMENT TO THE ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION TO PROVIDE THAT THE CITIZENS OF THE STATE OF ARKANSAS SHALL HAVE THE RIGHT TO KEEP AND BEAR ARMS FOR THEIR COMMON DEFENSE, FOR LAWFUL HUNTING AND RECREATIONAL USE, AND FOR ANY OTHER LAWFUL PURPOSE; PROVIDING THAT THE RIGHT TO KEEP AND BEAR ARMS INCLUDES WITHOUT LIMITATION THE POSSESSION AND USE OF AMMUNITION, FIREARM ACCESSORIES, AND FIREARM COMPONENTS; AND PROVIDING THAT THE RIGHT TO KEEP AND BEAR ARMS IS A NATURAL, FUNDAMENTAL, AND INDIVIDUAL RIGHT THAT SHALL NOT BE INFRINGED.
statewide.yes: A YES (FOR) vote replaces Article 2, sec. 5 with the new, longer right-to-bear-arms wording, starting Jan. 1, 2027.
statewide.no: A NO (AGAINST) vote keeps the current Article 2, sec. 5, which protects the right to keep and bear arms for the common defense.
statewide.needs: Each issue passes if more people vote FOR it than AGAINST it.

statewide.title: Economic development districts
statewide.what: AN AMENDMENT TO THE ARKANSAS CONSTITUTION CONCERNING ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT IN THE STATE OF ARKANSAS; AND AUTHORIZING THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY TO PROVIDE FOR THE CREATION OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT DISTRICTS WITHIN CITIES, COUNTIES, OR COOPERATIVE AREAS TO PROMOTE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT WITHIN THE ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT DISTRICT.
statewide.yes: A YES (FOR) vote lets the legislature pass laws creating economic development districts and funding programs, starting Jan. 1, 2027; no district is created by the vote itself.
statewide.no: A NO (AGAINST) vote keeps current constitutional limits; cities and counties keep only the development tools they have now (such as tax increment financing and existing bonds).
statewide.needs: Each issue passes if more people vote FOR it than AGAINST it.

statewide.title: $500 million water bonds
statewide.what: Arkansas Water, Waste Disposal, and Pollution Abatement Facilities Financing Act of 2025.
statewide.yes: A YES (FOR) vote lets the Arkansas Natural Resources Commission issue up to $500 million in state bonds, repaid over up to 35 years, starting July 1, 2027.
statewide.no: A NO (AGAINST) vote means no new bonds under this act; the legislature would need to use general revenue or other money for these water programs and federal matches.
statewide.needs: Each issue passes if more people vote FOR it than AGAINST it.
